title: Understanding Incomplete Dominance
text: In incomplete dominance, the heterozygote (Rr) shows a blended phenotype - pink in this case - rather than one allele masking the other.

title: Setting Up the Punnett Square
text: Place R and r from one parent on top, and R and r from the other parent on the side. Combine each row with each column: R+R=RR, R+r=Rr, r+R=Rr, r+r=rr
